title: Impactrakr Validation Rule (L3 spec + MvF-compliance fields)
description: Specification schema for every validation rule in the Impactrakr Validation Engine. L3 = ready for implementation + BV audit. Schema v0.2 adds the 4 MvF-compliance fields per Carrot dMRV Hub §3.4.6 + §3.5: event_ids, geographic_scope, action_on_failure, rule_type. These are OPTIONAL during migration (catalog v0.4.x → v0.5.x); will become required in v0.6+. Each rule must satisfy this contract.

id.description: Unique rule ID. Format: <PILLAR>-<2 digits>. P=PURE core, PG=PURE Gap, EU=EU adapter, RC=RecyClass gap.

title.description: Short rule title (≤ 100 chars). Verbatim from RULE_REGISTER.Rule Name when possible.

pillar.description: Which catalog this rule belongs to.

cluster.description: Functional cluster (used for filtering in HTML view). OTHER = not yet categorized; should migrate to specific cluster over time.

severity.description: Mirrors enum RuleSeverity in schema.prisma. BLOCK halts the flow; FLAG flags for manual review.

gates_what.description: When the rule fails (BLOCK), what specifically is blocked? TRC_ISSUANCE = emission of Tokenized Recycling Credit (PURE/PG). LEGAL_OPERATION = transport/ingest in EU legal scope (EU). RECYCLASS_CERTIFICATION = RecyClass annual certification (RC). HOMOLOGATION_APPROVAL = participant onboarding/renewal. REWARD_DISTRIBUTION = on-chain reward split. Critical to clarify scope of BLOCK for non-technical reviewers.

event.description: When the rule fires. Registry-agnostic per ADR-033.

phase.description: Phase within the event lifecycle. POST_CREATE/POST_UPDATE/POST_PUBLISH added in v0.2 to support PARTICIPANT_CREATE/UPDATE and TERMS_VERSION_PUBLISHED triggers.

conditions.description: Pre-conditions for the rule to fire (skip otherwise). Format: 'Model.field == value'. Empty array = always fires for the event.

secondary_triggers.description: Additional trigger events that fire the same rule. Used when a rule must re-evaluate on multiple lifecycle points (e.g., PARTICIPANT_CREATE + PARTICIPANT_UPDATE).

participant_types.description: Participant types impacted. G=Generator, B=Bin Custodian, H=Hauler, P=Processor, R=Recycler, INT=Integrator, NGO_BENEF=NGO Beneficiary, BUYER=Credit Buyer.

regions.description: Where the rule applies. GLOBAL = anywhere; MALTA is a subset of EU.

purpose.description: 1-2 paragraph plain-language statement of what this rule protects and why it exists. Written so a non-engineer (Lino, Julia) understands.

logic_human.description: Plain-English description of the validation logic. Reads as: 'BLOCK if X; PASS otherwise'.

logic_pseudocode.description: TypeScript-like pseudo-code of evaluate(ctx). Gabriel adapts to real stack. Must reference real schema fields.

when.description: Optional condition for when this evidence is required.

evidence.description: Documents that sustain the rule. May be empty for pure-logic rules.

block_pt.description: Message shown to user on BLOCK (Portuguese). Required when severity=BLOCK.

block_en.description: Message shown to user on BLOCK (English). Required when severity=BLOCK.

flag_pt.description: Message on FLAG (Portuguese). Required when severity=FLAG.

flag_en.description: Message on FLAG (English). Required when severity=FLAG.

flag_sandbox_pt.description: Optional sandbox-only message (Portuguese) for environment-aware rules.

flag_sandbox_en.description: Optional sandbox-only message (English) for environment-aware rules.

messages.description: Per-severity messages. Validation is conditional via allOf at rule level — see 'allOf' below. Block messages required if severity=BLOCK; flag messages required if severity=FLAG.

idempotent.description: Re-running with same input produces same result without side effects.

on_fail.description: What the system does when the rule fails. E.g. 'Write ValidationResult; halt MASSID_INGEST; surface block_pt/en to user; log to AuditLog.'

on_pass.description: What happens on pass. Usually 'Write ValidationResult(passed=true); silent to user; continue pipeline.'

revalidation.description: When (and if) the rule re-runs. E.g. 'Re-runs on every MASSID update; on dependency change; on operator manual re-trigger.'

retry_window.description: Optional. Time window in which the user can fix and re-submit before escalation.

escalation.description: Optional. What happens after retry_window expires. E.g. 'Escalate to Compliance review queue.'

expected.description: Expected result on failure: passed=false, message, field.

negative.description: 2-5 negative test cases covering distinct failure modes.

edge_cases.description: Known edge cases and how the rule handles them. E.g. 'Null kyc_status treated as incomplete.'

bv_controls.description: Bureau Veritas control IDs (from BV_CHECKLIST sheet) OR semantic control codes. Pattern accepts: BV-XX (legacy BV format) or SEMANTIC-NN (e.g., KYC-01, EXCLUSIVITY-01, CONSENT-01).

procedure.description: How the BV auditor verifies the rule (review evidence pack, check logs, etc.).

sample_size.description: BV sample size. E.g. '100% of rules', 'Sample 30 participants', 'Full scan'.

frequency.description: Audit frequency — free-text. Common values: 'Initial + annual', 'Annual', 'Semi-annual', 'Quarterly', 'Quarterly + ad-hoc', 'Monthly', 'On demand'. Free-text allows precise per-rule cadence.

related.description: Cross-references to other rules or BV controls with overlap or dependency.

quote.description: Optional verbatim quote (≤ 15 words to respect copyright).

references.description: Normative references that sustain the rule.

methodology_quote.description: Optional. Verbatim quote (≤ 25 words) from the PURE methodology that is the direct origin of this rule.

owner.description: Who owns the rule's content. Accepts compound owners (multiple groups co-owning) with or without spaces around the slash.

manual_review.description: Whether the rule requires human review when triggered (true typically for FLAG severity).

source_type.description: Source attribution (from RULE_REGISTER.Source Type column when applicable).

disposition.description: Disposition for the rule (from RULE_REGISTER when applicable).

odoo_objects.description: Odoo objects involved (from RULE_REGISTER when applicable). Informational only.

last_reviewed.description: ISO date of last review by owner.

audit_findings.description: Audit findings IDs from audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md that affect this rule (e.g. ['B-04', 'E-01']).

event_ids.description: MvF-compliance field per Carrot dMRV Hub §3.4.4 + §3.4.6. The event(s) in the catalog (E0..E12) where this rule is executed. Cross-event rules list multiple events. Empty/absent during migration (rules.json v0.4 → v0.5) — will be required after Phase E4 (Event Catalog) is completed for PURE.

geographic_scope.description: MvF-compliance field per Carrot dMRV Hub §3.5. Universal = rule applies regardless of territory. Territorial = rule has territory-specific parameters (e.g., manifest type BR=MTR vs EU=Annex VII). Territorial rules need a Geographical Adaptation Appendix entry. Empty during migration.

action_on_failure.description: MvF-compliance field per Carrot dMRV Hub §3.4.6. Finer-grained than the legacy `severity` (BLOCK/FLAG). Rejeição = data rejected at intake; Bloqueio = downstream operation blocked until regularization; Sinalização = flag for human review without blocking; Escalonamento = escalate to Compliance after retry window. During migration, derive from `severity` + `behavior.on_fail` semantics.

rule_type.description: MvF-compliance field per Carrot dMRV Hub §3.4.6. Orthogonal to `pillar`. Estrutura = integrity of form/completeness (independent of methodology content); Metodologia = conformity with PURE-specific criteria and parameters; Auditoria = consistency, cross-referencing, pattern-based checks requiring deeper analysis. During migration this is derived from current rule semantics.

is_new.description: Visual highlight flag for catalog UI. Marks rules recently created/imported (e.g., PG-18, PG-19, PG-20 from Onda 1 review). Optional metadata, no semantic impact on validation.

new_source.description: When is_new=true, brief description of where the rule came from (e.g., 'Gian recycler flow mapping (WhatsApp 01/jun)', 'Onda 1 review — Carrot-inspired split'). Provides traceability for recent additions.

validators.description: Optional. Documents per-field validators (regex, range, jurisdiction-specific checksums) for format/semantic validation rules like PG-01.

allOf.comment: If severity=BLOCK, require block_pt + block_en in messages.
If severity=FLAG, require flag_pt + flag_en in messages.
